description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Data Operations & Technical Oversight**

* Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
* Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
* Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
* Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
* Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
* Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

**Service Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
* Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
* Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
* Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
* Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
* Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
* Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
* Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

**Data Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
* Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
* Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – RCT**
**Staff – Python & Advanced SQL**
**Staff – Software Engineering**
**Experience: Strictly 2+ years**
**Eligibility requirement:**
Candidates must have 2–4 years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on cloud experience. Freshers, candidates with less than 2 years of experience, and candidates without cloud experience are not eligible for this role.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Join a financial crime technology team building data-driven solutions for global financial services clients. This role combines hands-on Python engineering, advanced SQL development, and practical exposure to Financial Crime Compliance processes. You will work with business, compliance, data, and engineering stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a hands-on software engineer with strong Python and advanced SQL skills and relevant Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. The successful candidate will develop and support data-intensive applications, analytical workflows, and rule-based solutions used in customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, investigations, and regulatory reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain Python applications, services, utilities, and data-processing workflows.
* Write complex, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, profiling, and investigation use cases.
* Work with large financial datasets, including customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data.
* Translate Financial Crime Compliance requirements into technical designs, data rules, scenarios, and reusable components.
* Support KYC and AML workflows such as customer onboarding, customer risk rating, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and periodic review.
* Contribute to Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud solutions, including rule implementation, threshold logic, alert generation, data validation, and issue analysis.
* Develop APIs, batch jobs, automation scripts, and integration components using Python.
* Perform unit testing, code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis, and production support.
* Collaborate with compliance SMEs, business analysts, data engineers, QA teams, and client stakeholders in Agile delivery teams.
* Follow secure coding, version-control, documentation, and deployment practices.

**Primary Skills – Must Have**

* Python: Strong hands-on programming experience, including data structures, functions, object-oriented programming, exception handling, modules, logging, testing, and performance-conscious coding.
* Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, query optimization, stored procedures, and data reconciliation.
* Databases: Practical experience with at least one relational database such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Data engineering: Experience processing structured data using Python libraries such as pandas and integrating with databases, files, or APIs.
* APIs and services: Working knowledge of REST APIs and Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Engineering practices: Git, unit testing, code review, debugging, documentation, and CI/CD fundamentals.
* Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Candidates should have practical experience developing, deploying, or supporting data-driven applications or services in a cloud environment.

**Good to have**

* Experience with PySpark or distributed data processing.
* Familiarity with orchestration or ETL tools such as Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
* Experience with data visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Understanding of model or rule performance measures, threshold tuning, false-positive reduction, and data lineage.
* Exposure to Agile delivery tools and practices, including Jira or Azure DevOps.

**Financial Crime domain knowledge**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, and remediation.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators, typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, and regulatory reporting concepts.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario or rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, back-testing, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlist concepts, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.

**Experience And Education**

* Experience: Strictly 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or technology delivery.
* Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with less than 2 years of relevant experience will not be considered.
* Cloud experience: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP is mandatory.
* Domain experience: Relevant delivery experience in KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, or Fraud is good to have.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Production-quality Python and SQL that is accurate, maintainable, secure, and efficient.
* Clear understanding of the business purpose and regulatory context behind the solution being built.
* Strong ownership of assigned deliverables, defects, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

description:

Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)
  
  
**Position Title:**
Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance & Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
  
  
**Function:**
Insurance
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Conversion SME will own the end-to-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life & Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
**Conversion Strategy & Governance**

* Define the end-to-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big-bang vs. phased/wave-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.

**Business & Technical Bridge**

* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source-of-truth calculations.
* Lead root-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.

**Data Mapping & Rules Definition**

* Author functional specifications for field-level, transaction-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims-in-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.

**Testing & Reconciliation**

* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy-level and aggregate-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.

**Team & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.

**Compliance & Risk**

* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.

Must-Have Skills
  
  
**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
9
  
  
**Platform**
Hands-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
  
  
**Conversion-specific**
Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
  
  
**Data**
Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
  
  
**Documentation**
Ability to write field-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting-grade standards
  
  
**Delivery**
Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
  
  
**Regulatory**
Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
  
  
**Preferred Skills**

* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross-domain flexibility)
* Vendor-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)

**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**

* LOMA certifications relevant to conversion/operations
* CSPO® / PMP® / Prosci (change management) for delivery-side credibility
* Platform-specific certifications (FAST, Majesco, FINEOS) where available

title: Sr. Database Engineer
description:
**Overview**

The
**Senior Database Engineer**
will be responsible for designing, implementing, optimizing, and maintaining database systems that support a national level initiative's complex and large-scale web and mobile applications. The role requires deep expertise in both relational and NoSQL databases, data warehousing, and cloud-based storage systems to ensure high availability, performance, and scalability of backend services. The engineer will work closely with cross-functional teams and ensure database components integrate seamlessly within a microservices-based architecture.

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities:**

1. Design, implement, and maintain relational and NoSQL databases including Amazon RDS, DynamoDB, and Redshift
2. Build and optimize data models, schema design, indexes, and stored procedures for high-performance web and mobile applications
3. Implement efficient data pipelines, ETL jobs, and transformations aligned with Redshift and S3-based architectures
4. Monitor and fine-tune performance of databases; analyze slow queries and manage indexes
5. Manage database access control, authentication, and security policies using Keycloak, JWT, and AES-256 encryption
6. Handle data caching and visualization integration using Redash and CloudFront
7. Support message-driven workflows and event-driven architecture involving RabbitMQ
8. Manage and optimize database networking and routing with API Gateway and ELB (Elastic Load Balancer)
9. Automate database deployment, monitoring, and alerting with Docker, Jenkins, AWS pipelines, ELK Stack, and OpenSearch
10. Ensure high availability, backups, disaster recovery, and data compliance
11. Collaborate with backend developers (Laravel PHP), DevOps, and frontend teams (React JS/React Native) to align database structure with application logic
12. Maintain detailed documentation on database design, processes, configurations, and access logs

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science/IT, Information Systems, or a related discipline
* Minimum 8+ years of hands-on experience in database engineering in large-scale, high-traffic environments
* Experience in cloud-based infrastructure
* Certifications in database administration (PostgreSQL, Redshift, or DynamoDB), or DevOps tools is a plus

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong hands-on experience with Amazon RDS, DynamoDB, Redshift, and S3 for scalable and secure data storage and processing
* Proficient in writing and optimizing SQL queries, stored procedures, and performing data modeling for high-performance applications
* Experience in building and managing ETL pipelines and handling large-scale data transformations
* Familiarity with Redash for data visualization and CloudFront for content caching and delivery
* Good understanding of RabbitMQ for asynchronous communication in a microservices environment
* Skilled in managing APIs through API Gateway and Elastic Load Balancer (ELB) for secure and scalable API traffic routing
* Knowledge of Keycloak for identity and access management, with implementation experience of JWT tokens and AES-256 encryption
* Proficient in Docker for containerization and managing deployments using Jenkins, AWS pipelines, and Git
* Experience with system monitoring and logging tools like ELK Stack and OpenSearch
* Strong analytical thinking, collaboration, and documentation skills with the ability to work effectively across development, DevOps, and security teams

title: Implementation Consultant
description:
**About the Company -**

Algoworks is an award-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience

transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and

India. We bring together a global team of engineers, architects, designers, researchers and

operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable

results.

For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the

Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful

business outcomes. Our work combines human-centered design, engineering excellence

and AI-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision.

Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams

approach problem-solving and continuous improvement.

At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across

geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and

collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment

where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the

intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong

global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

**Role Overview-**

The Implementation Consultant (IC) turns client requirements into a working, tested and

documented Gotransverse configuration with speed and precision. The IC works alongside

the Executive Sponsor, Project Manager, Business Analyst, Solution Architect and QA to

translate business requirements into platform configuration, support testing and

reconciliation, and ensure successful implementation and handover.

The role combines billing domain knowledge, hands-on platform skills, analytical thinking

and client-facing communication to deliver accurate and reliable configurations.

**Key Responsibilities-**

1. Discovery & Requirements

• Run working sessions with clients and translate contract terms and business

scenarios into configurable requirements.

• Ask clarifying questions to understand the business need behind client requests.

• Challenge unclear requirements and recommend best practices.

• Ensure requirements are traceable to corresponding build elements.

• Understand design specifications to determine implementation next steps.

2. Platform Configuration & Build

• Configure the catalog, charges, lookup tables, custom fields, SRIDs, mediation

streams and integrations.

• Translate documented requirements into accurate Gotransverse configurations.

• Validate configuration changes and check work before handing it off.

• Ensure configuration and runbook documentation remain current as the build

changes.

3. Testing & Reconciliation

• Write and execute test cases.

• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and regression testing after changes.

• Reconcile system output against source data and client expectations.

• Investigate and explain variances between system output and source data.

• Triage defects and distinguish data issues, configuration gaps, new requirements

and product bugs.

4. Demo Preparation & Execution

• Prepare and conduct client demonstrations.

• Tailor demo scripts to the audience.

• Stage clean demo data and dry-run end-to-end scenarios.

• Capture feedback, document follow-ups and communicate next steps.

5. Cutover, Go-Live & Handover

• Support cutover, go-live and hypercare activities.

• Contribute to migration, parallel-run and rollback planning.

• Maintain relevant configuration and runbook documentation.

• Ensure a clean transition to support and Customer Success teams.

6. Client & Internal Communication

• Provide clear and organized updates to clients and internal teams.

• Adjust communication for executive and technical audiences.

• Escalate risks and issues early.

• Work closely with the Executive Sponsor, Project Manager, Business Analyst, Solution Architect and QA.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies**

**Core Technical Skills-**

• Strong SQL skills to query and validate data independently and reconcile counts and totals.

• Understanding of JSON and APIs, including building payloads, authentication, error handling and pagination.

• Data analysis skills, including Excel pivots, lookups, identifying outliers and explaining variances.

• Ability to work with configuration data and validate system outputs against source

data.

**Delivery & Implementation -**

• Understanding of requirements traceability and the ability to map requirements to

configuration elements.

• Ability to write test cases, execute UAT and regression testing, and reconcile outputs with source data.

• Understanding of defect triage and the ability to distinguish data issues, configuration gaps, new requirements and product bugs.

• Familiarity with cutover, go-live, migration, parallel runs, rollback planning and

hypercare.

**Consulting & Client Engagement -**

• Ability to conduct discovery sessions and clarify business requirements.

• Ability to recommend best practices rather than only implementing requested

changes.

• Strong demo preparation and execution skills.

• Ability to communicate clearly with both executive and technical stakeholders.

**Must-Have Skills -**

• SQL and data validation.

• Data analytics and reconciliation.

• Understanding of JSON and APIs.

• Requirements analysis and traceability.

• Testing, UAT and regression testing.

• Configuration validation and defect triage.

• Client communication and stakeholder management.

• Strong attention to detail and precise execution.

**Good to Have Skills -**

• Experience with billing platforms or subscription management systems.

• Familiarity with Gotransverse.

• Experience with mediation streams and integrations.

• Exposure to cutover, migration, parallel runs and hypercare.

**Desired Attributes -**

• Fast, detailed and precise in execution.

• Checks own work before handing it off.

• Organized and clear in client and internal communication.

• Able to adapt communication for executives and technical teams.

• Curious and comfortable challenging unclear requirements.

• Commercially and operationally practical.

• Focused on recommending best practices.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: IBM MQ ADMIN
description:
IBM MQ Lead / MQ Administrator
  
Salary -4- 8 lpa(depending on experience)
  
Employment Type-Full-Time
  
Exp- 2-5
  
  
  
About the Company
  
We are a leading aviation IT solutions provider specializing in mission-critical airport systems integration, enterprise middleware, operational technology platforms, and digital transformation solutions for airports and aviation stakeholders. Our projects involve complex, high-availability environments requiring secure, scalable, and resilient system integrations across multiple airport operational systems.
  
We are seeking a highly skilled MQ Administrator to manage, optimize, and support enterprise messaging and middleware infrastructure in demanding, 24x7 operational environments.
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are looking for an experienced IBM MQ Lead / Administrator with strong technical and leadership capabilities to manage enterprise messaging environments and production support operations.
  
The candidate will be responsible for providing technical leadership, managing day-to-day MQ operations, handling critical incidents, coordinating with L2/L3 teams, and ensuring timely resolution and closure of issues. The role requires strong client-facing skills, ownership of production activities, and the ability to lead support teams in a 24x7 environment.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Lead and manage IBM MQ administration and production support activities across multiple environments.
  
Provide technical leadership to the MQ support team and guide team members in troubleshooting and issue resolution.
  
Take ownership of critical and complex incidents and drive them through to resolution and closure.
  
Analyze production issues, identify the impacted areas, and coordinate with relevant technical teams for resolution.
  
Coordinate with L2, L3, application, infrastructure, network, security, and vendor teams to resolve complex issues within agreed SLAs.
  
Act as the primary technical point of contact for MQ-related issues and operational activities.
  
Lead incident calls and ensure clear communication between technical teams, stakeholders, and clients.
  
Provide regular and accurate status updates to clients and management during critical incidents.
  
Coordinate with L2/L3 teams for detailed troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions.
  
Ensure issues are properly tracked, resolved, validated, and formally closed.
  
Review recurring incidents and coordinate with relevant teams to identify permanent solutions and preventive measures.
  
Manage and coordinate shift operations, including shift handovers, pending activities, critical incidents, and operational priorities.
  
Ensure adequate coverage and smooth execution of 24x7 production support and shift activities.
  
Coordinate planned activities, changes, deployments, maintenance, and testing with respective teams.
  
Review and approve operational activities, implementation plans, rollback plans, and troubleshooting approaches where applicable.
  
Participate in client meetings, governance calls, service reviews, and technical discussions.
  
Translate technical issues into clear business-impact updates for clients and stakeholders.
  
Ensure adherence to operational procedures, SLA requirements, change management processes, and support standards.
  
Prepare and review RCA, incident reports, operational reports, and other support documentation.
  
Identify operational gaps and drive improvements in support processes, monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident management.
  
Mentor and guide junior team members and help build technical capability within the support team.
  
Coordinate knowledge transfer and ensure proper documentation of critical systems and operational procedures.
  
Work closely with management to identify resource requirements, operational risks, and support priorities.
  
Leadership & Client Management
  
Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability for MQ operations and production support.
  
Lead technical discussions with clients and internal stakeholders.
  
Effectively manage communication during high-priority and critical incidents.
  
Coordinate multiple teams simultaneously to drive issues toward closure.
  
Ensure clear assignment of actions, ownership, and timelines during incident and technical calls.
  
Escalate issues appropriately and ensure timely involvement of L2/L3 teams when required.
  
Follow up with respective teams until the issue is completely resolved and validated.
  
Ensure proper closure of incidents with appropriate RCA and preventive actions.
  
Build strong working relationships with clients, vendors, and internal technical teams.
  
Act as a bridge between the support team, L2/L3 technical teams, and the client.
  
Technical Responsibilities
  
Strong understanding of IBM MQ administration and enterprise messaging concepts.
  
Manage and troubleshoot MQ-related connectivity, messaging, queue, channel, security, and performance issues.
  
Perform MQ health checks and monitor the overall health of messaging environments.
  
Support MQ configuration, maintenance, deployments, and production changes.
  
Troubleshoot message flow issues and coordinate with application/integration teams.
  
Support high-availability, disaster-recovery, and infrastructure-related MQ activities.
  
Analyze logs and technical information to identify the root cause of issues.
  
Work with infrastructure, network, security, and application teams when issues span multiple technology areas.
  
Shift & Operations Management
  
Lead assigned shifts and ensure smooth execution of production support activities.
  
Review open incidents, pending activities, planned changes, and operational priorities at the start of each shift.
  
Ensure proper handover between shifts.
  
Coordinate resources during major incidents and production outages.
  
Ensure all critical issues are followed up until resolution and closure.
  
Maintain operational discipline and ensure SLA commitments are met.
  
Support on-call and 24x7 operations as required.
  
Required Skills
  
6+ years of experience in IBM MQ administration/support.
  
Strong production support and incident management experience.
  
Strong leadership and coordination skills.
  
Experience working with L2/L3 technical teams.
  
Strong client-facing and communication skills.
  
Experience handling critical incidents and driving them to closure.
  
Experience working in 24x7 shift environments.
  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  
Good understanding of enterprise integration and messaging environments.
  
Ability to coordinate across multiple technical teams.
  
Experience with ITIL/service management processes is preferred.
  
Experience with incident, problem, change, and release management is preferred.
  
Ideal Candidate Profile
  
The ideal candidate should be a technically strong MQ professional with proven leadership experience, capable of independently managing production support, leading shifts, handling critical incidents, coordinating with L2/L3 teams, and managing client communication.
  
The candidate should demonstrate strong ownership, decision-making, coordination, communication, and issue-closure capabilities, rather than being limited to individual technical troubleshooting.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

+ Independent leadership of requirements-gathering and process workshops
+ Proven ability to convert requirements into Functional and Technical Design Documents
+ Experience aligning technology with strategic business goals in large, global organizations

* 2+ years of application support and management experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or Oracle E-Business Suite (preferably R12)
* 2+ successful end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations
* 5–6 years of deep expertise in: Order-to-Cash processes and applications, including Oracle CPQ, Order Management, Service Contracts, Advanced Pricing, Shipping Execution, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, and General Ledger
* Hands-on proficiency with SQL, PL/SQL, REST APIs, JSON, Oracle Integration Cloud, Visual Builder, BICC, Redwood extension patterns, Oracle APEX, and Oracle Cloud extension frameworks
* Custom report and dashboard development using Oracle Reports, BI Publisher, OTBI, and similar tools
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with: Oracle Embedded AI & Oracle AI Agent Studio., Redwood UI and Redwood application extensions, Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS)

* Experience with Procure-to-Pay and Record-to-Report Oracle ERP process areas
* Oracle Certification (e.g., Oracle Certified Professional)
* Proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, and ServiceNow
* Experience with Zuora RevPro

Every day your individual efforts can contribute to the lives of millions.

title: NetSuite Technical Senior Consultant
description:

**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
  
  
As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.
  
  
Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
  
  
We are seeking a skilled and motivated
**NetSuite Technical Senior Consultant**
to join our growing NetSuite consulting team in India. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, configuring, integrating, and supporting NetSuite ERP solutions that address client business requirements.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in SuiteScript, JavaScript, NetSuite customizations, and system integrations, along with hands-on experience supporting ERP implementations and enhancements. You will collaborate with functional consultants, technical leads, and project teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-quality NetSuite solutions.
  
  
This opportunity is well-suited for a technical professional who enjoys solving complex problems, working in a collaborative consulting environment, and continuing to develop expertise in the NetSuite ecosystem.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**NetSuite Configuration & Development**

* Configure and customize NetSuite features, including custom forms, fields, records, workflows, roles, and permissions.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance SuiteScript solutions using SuiteScript 2.x, including Client Scripts, User Event Scripts, Suitelets, RESTlets, and Map/Reduce scripts.
* Create and optimize saved searches, reports, dashboards, and workflows to support business requirements.
* Perform data imports, exports, and migrations using NetSuite CSV tools and other supported methods.
* Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, RESTlets, and SFTP/flat-file interfaces.
* Follow established technical design standards, development methodologies, and coding best practices.

**Implementation, Delivery & Support**

* Execute technical development activities based on approved solution designs and functional specifications.
* Support NetSuite implementation projects through configuration, development, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Troubleshoot technical issues, resolve defects, and implement system enhancements.
* Analyze technical requirements and collaborate with senior team members to identify appropriate solutions.
* Provide ongoing application support, investigate reported issues, and deliver timely resolutions.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential improvements, escalating complex issues when appropriate.

**Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Develop and execute unit testing and support user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Participate in defect triage, root cause analysis, and issue resolution.
* Validate technical solutions through regression testing and quality assurance activities.
* Participate in peer code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve solution quality and maintainability.

**Documentation & Deployment**

* Prepare and maintain technical documentation for scripts, configurations, integrations, and customizations.
* Support release management, deployment tracking, and development activities using Azure DevOps or similar tools.
* Maintain accurate documentation of technical changes, testing outcomes, and deployment activities.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with NetSuite functional consultants, technical leads, project managers, and other delivery team members.
* Communicate technical progress, challenges, and resolutions clearly to internal stakeholders.
* Contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives, technical discussions, and development best practices.
* Stay current with NetSuite platform enhancements, SuiteScript capabilities, and emerging integration technologies.
* Actively pursue relevant NetSuite certifications and professional development opportunities.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in ERP technical development, software development, or technical consulting, including hands-on NetSuite development experience.
* Strong working knowledge of the NetSuite ERP platform, including customizations, configurations, workflows, and saved searches.
* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining SuiteScript 2.x solutions, including Client Scripts, User Event Scripts, Suitelets, RESTlets, or Map/Reduce scripts.
* Proficiency in JavaScript, including debugging, troubleshooting, and applying coding best practices.
* Working knowledge of system integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, or other integration technologies.
* Experience supporting ERP implementations, enhancements, technical deployments, or production support activities.
* Familiarity with data migration and management using NetSuite CSV import/export functionality.
* Experience performing unit testing, troubleshooting technical defects, and supporting UAT activities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate across technical and functional teams.
* Ability to manage assigned deliverables, meet project timelines, and work effectively in a collaborative consulting environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on multiple NetSuite implementation, optimization, or support projects.
* NetSuite certifications, such as SuiteFoundation, SuiteCloud Developer, or other relevant technical certifications.
* Experience with advanced SuiteScript development, performance optimization, and complex customizations.
* Exposure to NetSuite integration frameworks, SuiteTalk REST/SOAP web services, and third-party integration platforms.
* Familiarity with SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), SuiteCloud CLI, or automated deployment practices.
* Experience using Azure DevOps, Git, or similar version control and release management tools.

* Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning, technical excellence, and knowledge sharing.

title: MSFDL-Manager - Data Audit Framework
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

We are looking for a skilled Data Consultant with 3-5 years of experience in building and developed enterprise-grade applications. You will work within the Digital Solutions team to build scalable, secure, and high performing business applications used across major global infrastructure and environmental projects.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to support the ongoing development of digital solutions for our client’s, unlocking solutions to the world’s most critical challenges. * Knowledge of enterprise data governance, security, deployment pipelines, row-level security (RLS), workspace management, and data refresh strategies.
* Ability to leverage Generative AI, Python, and SQL to automate business processes, enhance productivity, and develop innovative data-driven solutions.
* Skilled in extracting, transforming, modeling, and analyzing complex datasets using Python, SQL Server, and AI technologies, enabling continuous process improvement and advanced analytics.

description:

We are seeking an experienced
**SAP CCM**
with
**8 to 10 years**

**SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebate processing, accruals, and settlement logic—backed by robust knowledge of
**SAP SD and Pricing**
.
  
  
In this role, you will lead complex enhancements, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support in an S/4HANA enterprise environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enhancements & Application Development (AD)**

* Process Enhancement & Delivery: Lead the design and delivery of CCM enhancements, including new condition contract types, specialized settlement logic, and custom rebate models tailored to evolving business requirements.
* Functional Specifications: Gather business requirements and translate them into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for custom RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement parameters, and cross-module integration points.
* Development & Testing: Partner closely with technical (ABAP) teams through development, unit testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure defect-free production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process optimization and automation initiatives within CCM and pricing operational workflows.

**Application Maintenance & Production Support (AM)**

* L2/L3 Incident Management: Deliver high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM operations, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs and minimal business disruption.
* Troubleshooting & Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing discrepancies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring defects and implement permanent preventive fixes.
* ITSM Governance: Efficiently manage incidents, problem records, and service requests within ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and support period-end settlement runs and corresponding financial postings.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance**

* Integration Alignment: Collaborate with SD and FI teams to resolve complex, cross-module integration issues and ensure seamless Order-to-Cash (O2C) processing.
* Change Management: Adhere strictly to change management, transport release, and governance protocols for all system enhancements.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain detailed functional documentation, conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions, and promote standard SAP best practices.

**Required Candidate Profile**

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP hands-on experience covering both Application Support (AMS) and Enhancements/Implementations in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Core Functional Expertise: Deep domain expertise in SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)—rebates, accruals, settlements, and contract maintenance.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid expertise in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) and advanced SAP Pricing Procedure configurations.
* Technical Interface Skills: Proven track record of designing functional specs for custom RICEF objects and working with ABAP teams.
* Support Proficiency: Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and standard ITIL support processes.

description:

382656
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

The Storage Engineering team is seeking a Senior / Lead Infrastructure Engineer with deep expertise in enterprise storage platforms, data protection ecosystems, and automation frameworks to lead validation and testing efforts. + High-velocity patch distribution and deployment workflows
+ Storage performance during patching (IOPS, throughput, latency)

+ NetApp FAS (multi-protocol access for distributed repositories)
+ StorageGRID (S3 object storage for artifacts, staging, and distribution)
+ Cohesity (backup, recovery, and cyber resilience)

* Build reusable automation frameworks and integrate into CI/CD pipelines for continuous validation
* Use Terraform (IaC) to provision and validate storage environments optimized for rapid patching

+ Data integrity and consistency of patch artifacts
+ High-volume data movement across environments and endpoints

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

* Expertise in:

+ High-volume data delivery and validation
+ Backup/restore, replication, and DR at scale
+ Data integrity and large artifact handling
+ Terraform (IaC) and CI/CD integration
+ Advanced troubleshooting across storage, compute, and distributed systems

* Direct experience supporting accelerated patching initiatives or large-scale update delivery environments
* Multi-cloud storage architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Kubernetes/CSI storage integrations
* Performance benchmarking for high-throughput systems
* Observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk)

* Act as SME for storage and data infrastructure with a focus on accelerating patching across storage systems
* Lead cross-functional initiatives across Storage, DevOps, and Platform Engineering teams
* Deliver scalable, production-grade automation for validation and patch delivery workflows
* Drive improvements in system performance, scalability, resiliency, and patch deployment velocity

description:

The

will be responsible for managing and optimizing the databases supporting the MY Bharat Platform. The role involves overseeing database provisioning, performance tuning, backups, high availability, and security. The ideal candidate will have experience with cloud-native databases, particularly
**Amazon RDS**
,
**DynamoDB**
, and
**Redshift**
, and will ensure the integrity, reliability, and scalability of data infrastructure for both web and mobile applications.

**Responsibilities:**

1. Manage and maintain production and development databases on RDS, DynamoDB, and Redshift.
2. Ensure database availability, performance, and security across environments.
3. Design and implement efficient schemas, indexes, queries, and procedures to optimize database performance.
4. Set up and manage backups, disaster recovery plans, and data replication across environments.
5. Monitor database health and implement proactive measures to prevent downtime or data loss.
6. Work closely with development teams to support database needs and troubleshoot data-related issues.
7. Assist in data migration, transformation, and ETL processes across modules.
8. Implement and maintain role-based access control and encryption mechanisms (e.g., AES-256).
9. Manage database logs and integrate monitoring tools like ELK Stack and OpenSearch.
10. Support DevOps in implementing CI/CD pipelines with database versioning and rollback capabilities.

description:

We are looking for a Senior SCOM Expert & SQL Database Administrator Specialist with 5–10 years of experience to join our IAM infrastructure and data operations team in Noida. Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Position Summary**
This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing Global Support Organization and provide World class Support for all Thales products.
  
  
Thales is a leading global provider of data protection solutions with more than 40 years’ experience securing the world’s most sensitive information. Our customers—businesses, governments, and technology vendors with a broad range of challenges use Thales e-Security products and services to improve the security of applications that rely on encryption and digital signatures.

As a member of a collaborative Client Services team, the Escalation Engineer will provide product escalation support to the Client Services Tech support team, for specific product, in constructing complex customer deployments, analyzing for root causes, recommending remediation procedures or best practices and documenting test methods, processes and knowledge bases. In addition, this position is responsible for validating proper interoperability of Thales products with other third-party vendor software/Solutions

This will include various OS platforms, storage products, databases, file systems, security protection software, HA clustering software, etc. The candidate must be a strategic thinker, well organized and able to work within fast-paced engineering environments and is also expected via collaboration with the broader Technical Support, QA and Developer teams to drive continual improvements to our processes and methodologies, all with the goal of continually improving the product quality and customer experience.

* Identify and champion product enhancement requests as customer advocates.
* Create knowledge and support articles, webinars, white papers, and other materials that help customers use Thales products.
* Other duties as assigned

**Technical Knowledge/Skills & Experience Required**
**Essential:**

* Operating Systems & Infrastructure Strong Linux & Windows Server administration skills System performance analysis (CPU, memory, disk, processes, services) Log analysis and troubleshooting Virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V) Basic cloud exposure (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Networking fundamentals TCP/IP, DNS, routing, NAT, VPN concepts Packet capture and analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump) Load balancer concepts
* Database Knowledge Strong understanding of databases (Oracle, MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, DB2, MySQL) SQL query analysis and troubleshooting Database performance fundamentals Understanding of DB connectivity/authentication Replication and HA concepts
* Security & Compliance Fundamentals Vulnerability and risk concepts Encryption fundamentals Compliance standards awareness (PCI-DSS, SOX, HIPAA, GDPR)
* Diagnostic Tools Wireshark, tcpdump, curl/Postman, Fiddler, Splunk/Kibana basics, Database tracing tools

Basic scripting (Bash, Python, PowerShell, REST API fundamentals, JSON/XML parsing)
  
  
Automation mindset for repetitive diagnostics
  
  
Basic Git familiarity
  
  
**Troubleshooting & Escalation Skills**

* Analytical & Troubleshooting skills
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Complex log correlation
* Crisis Management
* Reproducing customer issues in lab environments
* Performance bottleneck identification
* Clear technical documentation skills
* Strong ownership and accountability mindset
* Ability to independently lead P1/P0 customer escalations
* Mentorship and enablement of Support teams
* Trend analysis and recurrence prevention
* Contribution to KBs, tooling, automation, and process improvements
* Strong understanding of enterprise customer environments and deployment patterns

**Educational Requirements**

**Professional Attributes**
**Demonstrates the Thales Values:**

* Focus on Customers
* Perform through teaming
* Innovate, decide and act quickly
* Develop our people
* Proactive - Develops practical solutions, takes ownership, has a ‘can do' rather than ‘won’t do’ approach
* Technically curious – Regards technology problems as challenges

* Creative – Connects the technical dots with a goal of building customer value
* Responsive - Always reacts quickly and with a sense of urgency to requests, issues, e-mails or other events in a timely and flexible fashion

**Work Environment**

* The working environment is generally indoors in environmentally controlled conditions where lighting and temperature are adequate, and there are no hazardous conditions. Work is generally performed within an office environment, with standard office equipment available.

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**Job Description**
CSS Innovation Studios is seeking Senior Data Engineers/Architects with deep expertise in PySpark and data engineering to deliver strategic AI and data-transformation programs for Oracle’s largest enterprise customers.
  
  
In this senior, customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize enterprise-scale data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will work directly with CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, chief architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize legacy data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.
  
  
The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems supporting generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; lead complex platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply and evolve Oracle product capabilities through real-world customer deployments.
  
  

* 10–12+ years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms.
* Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Principal Solution Architect, Consulting Engineer, or technical leader in professional services.
* Expert knowledge of one or more modern cloud data platforms like Databricks
* Extensive hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, Scala or Java, Kafka and modern data ecosystems.
* Exposure to building autonomous agents and orchestration pipelines.
* Deep expertise in Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance engineering, optimization, and tuning at scale.
* Demonstrated success modernizing enterprise analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads.
* Must have a solid understanding of networking concepts to design and optimize data transmission networks, configure network settings, and diagnose and resolve network-related issues.
* Strong understanding of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability.
* Outstanding executive communication, customer advisory, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Responsibilities**
Lead architecture and delivery of enterprise Oracle AI Data Platform transformations, including platform implementations and migrations.
  
  

* Design and build scalable, governed, AI-ready data architectures, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products.
* Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns.
* Build AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines, including feature engineering, feature extraction, MLOps workflows, and vector-ready datasets.
* Assess and modernize workloads by refactoring PySpark and ETL code and optimizing Spark configuration, cluster sizing, partitioning, memory, adaptive query execution, reliability, and performance at scale.
* Develop APIs, SDKs, web applications, and automation frameworks that simplify adoption of Oracle AI Data Platform and Generative AI services.
* Create reusable migration accelerators, reference architectures, automation frameworks, and delivery methodologies.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and field teams to solve complex technical challenges; share customer insights to inform product roadmaps.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout customer engagements.
* Mentor senior engineers globally, promote engineering excellence across CSS, and continuously evaluate emerging AI, cloud, and data-engineering practices.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
