Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.
* Automation & Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain Python and shell scripts to automate administrative activities, streamline deployments, minimize manual interventions, reduce recurring incidents and standardize operational processes.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: Provision, administer and support Oracle environments on cloud platforms, particularly OCI, and contribute to on-premises-to-cloud migration, infrastructure modernization and operational integration initiatives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
* Experience managing WebLogic components such as JDBC, Data Sources, JMS, SSL and application deployments (WAR/EAR/EJB).
* Understanding of multi-node application infrastructure, load balancing, networking and application-tier configurations.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage production-critical environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
* Willingness to work in rotational 24×7 shifts, including weekends when required.

**Good-to-Have**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration, provisioning and migration experience.
* OCI certification.
* Experience with other cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SOA, OBIEE, Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager (OAM)
* Experience with advanced WebLogic configurations, including Distributed JMS, Foreign JMS Providers, Message Bridges and WLST automation.
* Exposure to Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
* Experience implementing cross-data-center disaster recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
* Experience driving operational improvements through proactive monitoring, automation and performance tuning.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Apps DBA and/or Fusion Middleware administration, with strong expertise in one domain and practical working knowledge of the other?
* Have I independently administered Oracle Applications 11i/R12 environments or Oracle WebLogic/Fusion Middleware platforms, including installations, configurations, patching, cloning, upgrades or troubleshooting in production?
* Can I troubleshoot Oracle Database, RAC/Data Guard, WebLogic clustering, load balancing, JDBC/JMS, SSL or multi-node application issues to maintain high availability and meet production SLAs?
* Have I used Linux/Unix administration skills and Python or shell scripting to automate operational tasks, reduce manual effort and resolve recurring infrastructure or application issues?
* Am I comfortable independently supporting mission-critical environments, coordinating with customers and technical teams, and working rotational 24×7 shifts including weekends?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

* Provide strong, hands-on support in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues within MSFT F&O environments.
* Contribute to technical design sessions, code development, peer reviews, and deployment planning.
* Identify, analyze, and resolve system defects and data inconsistencies to ensure system stability.
* Support monitoring of system performance and proactively help maintain optimal system health.

**Cross-Functional Technical Contributions**

* Implement minor-to-medium complexity enhancements, bug fixes, and integrations.
* Assist in developing and maintaining integrations leveraging Power Platform, Azure Logic Apps, or related Microsoft cloud services.
* Utilize telemetry, monitoring tools, and analytical insights to troubleshoot performance bottlenecks and improve reliability.

**Operational Excellence & Documentation**

* Own incident resolution workflows, ensuring accurate documentation and timely stakeholder updates.
* Contribute to internal knowledge assets such as SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks.
* Support automation initiatives for deployments, environment refreshes, and operational tasks using DevOps practices.

**Expectations**
**Continuous Learning & Innovation**

* Actively explore new features and capabilities across Dynamics 365 and the Microsoft Cloud ecosystem.
* Participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, team learning, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Leadership, Collaboration & Communication**

* Coordinate effectively with cross-regional technical and functional teams.
* Communicate confidently with U.S.-based stakeholders, often during overlapping working hours.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and analysts.
* Explain technical solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical audience groups.

**Required Skills**
**Mandatory**

* 8+ years hands-on experience in MSFT F&O (AX/F&O) technical development and support, including X++, LCS, debugging, and data entity integrations.
* Strong experience identifying and resolving performance, functional, and integration issues across the F&O stack (SQL DB, AOS, services, SSRS reports).
* Solid proficiency in X++ development, OOP principles, performance optimization, and scalable design.
* Experience with source control and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Azure DevOps).
* Strong analytical skills, structured problem-solving approach, and strong attention to detail.
* Excellent English communication skills with the ability to interface directly with global stakeholders.
* Ability to operate with moderate supervision and take ownership of assigned tasks.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with REST/OData services, Dual-write integrations, and middleware technologies.
* Exposure to monitoring and telemetry tools such as LCS monitoring, Application Insights, Azure Monitor, and Power BI.
* Familiarity with Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) solutions.
* Basic understanding of Azure architecture components relevant to integrations.

title: OneStream IT Specialist
description:
**Req ID:**
391195
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a OneStream IT Specialist to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Description**
: OneStream IT Specialist with Financial Services Domain Knowledge
  
  
**Role Overview**
This position combines IT expertise in the OneStream platform with deep knowledge of financial services processes to deliver, enhance, and operate enterprise finance solutions. The candidate will act as a bridge between finance, IT, and business stakeholders, ensuring that financial consolidation, planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytics processes are optimized
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead the design and architecture of OneStream solutions from Finance IT side, ensuring best practices are followed by vendor team.
  
  
Translate business needs into functional requirements technical design documentation, including requirements and RTM., user stories, process maps, solution designs, and acceptance criteria.
  
  
Define solution structure, including system integrations, data flows, and financial reporting.
  
  
Provide design input for customized workflows, calculations, and financial models.
  
  
Support OneStream capabilities for financial close, consolidation, planning, forecasting, management reporting, and analytics
  
  
Oversee OneStream implementation, including configuration, testing, and deployment.
  
  
Lead data migration and integration with ERP and financial systems.
  
  
Serve as the primary Finance IT contact, providing expert guidance and support throughout the implementation.
  
  
Provide training to user community on OneStream functionality and best practices.
  
  
Mentor cross-functional teams, offering architectural guidance to ensure successful application development.
  
  
Develop test plans/cases, coordinate UAT, and validate solutions meet business and control requirements
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
8-10 years of relevant EPM solution implementation experience with 3+ years OneStream experience
  
  
Experience in building metadata, business rules, forms, designing cube views, workflow, performing data reconciliation, building custom rules and reports
  
  
Proficient in SQL, Excel, and scripting languages such as VB.net.

Strong understanding of financial services processes, including consolidation, planning, forecasting, and compliance.
  
  
Ability to translate complex business needs into technical solutions and communicate clearly across functions

Hybrid or on-site depending on employer; will involve global collaboration.

title: Senior CloudOps Engineer
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Position Summary**
A Senior CloudOps Developer bridges development and operations to design, automate, and operate the cloud platform that powers our CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service. This role combines strong software engineering and operational skills to ensure reliable, scalable, and observable systems are delivered and maintained in production.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Support the full application and infrastructure stack to ensure the CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service remains highly available, secure, performant, and reliable.
* Design, implement, and maintain observability, monitoring, and synthetic testing to detect issues early and validate service behavior end-to-end.
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide timely incident response through PagerDuty and related operational processes.
* Lead or support disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution to ensure business continuity and recovery readiness.
* Define, track, and continuously improve SLOs/SLIs to align platform reliability with business expectations.
* Produce clear and actionable monthly operations reports summarizing service health, trends, incidents, and improvement opportunities.
* Leverage Datadog to analyze logs, create and maintain monitoring metrics, and configure dashboards and alerts that support CloudOps activities and platform reliability.
* Analyze operational data and platform metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, reliability gaps, and opportunities for automation or optimization.
* Design, build, and maintain automation and internal tooling to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across the CloudOps environment.
* Deploy, configure, and maintain application and platform layers of the service, ensuring changes are implemented safely and in accordance with standards.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders to review designs, provide feedback, and help shape scalable and resilient solutions.
* Review peer code and infrastructure changes to ensure quality, maintainability, and compliance with team standards and best practices.
* Develop, test, and document automation and platform components, including runbooks and operational procedures, to support long-term maintainability and operational readiness.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or CloudOps, with 3+ years of building and operating cloud-native platforms

+ Development Application side Experience in deploying and supporting cloud-based applications.
+ Ability to think in a Cloud Services manner.
+ Experience with orchestration toolsets.

* Operations

+ Understanding of operational concepts like change management, on call rotations, escalations, uptime, etc...
+ Experience in managing production systems on a very large scale.
+ Experience working with virtualization: VMWare, Hyper-V, etc...
+ Experience working with DB’s: MSSQL, MySQL, Postgres, Mongo, Cassandra, etc...

* Software Development Experience with cloud and server architecture

+ Experience with REST APIs, microservices development and deployment.
+ Experience with security-relevant protocols

* OS

+ Deep understanding of one of the major OS families (Linux or Windows)

* Security

+ Conscious of security concerns
+ Adhere to security best practices from design to implementation and operations

* Automation

+ Experience with automation technologies (Terraform, Cloud formation, Ansible)
+ Experience with CaaS or PaaS technologies (K8s, OpenShift, etc...)
+ Experience with IaaS technologies (OpenStack, Azure Stack, etc...)

* Public and Private Cloud

+ Experience with Public cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)
+ Experience with Private hosting (Private data centers, Rackspace, etc...)

* Interaction & Communication

+ Good social interaction with the immediate team as well as other teams
+ Ability to work in an extremely geographically distributed company
+ Excellent communication skills across multiple mediums.

* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in computer science

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Data Solutions Architect 3rd
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
A career in our Business Intelligence practice, within Data and Analytics Technology services, will provide you with the opportunity to help organizations uncover enterprise insights and drive business results using smarter data analytics. Leveraging a collection of organizational technology capabilities, including business intelligence, data management, and data assurance, we help our clients drive innovation, growth, and change within their organization using business intelligence.
  
  
Our rapid business intelligence solutions, data visualization, and integrated reporting dashboards allow our team to deliver agile, highly interactive reporting and analytics that help our clients to run their business, understand what business questions can be answered and how to unlock the business drivers more effectively.
  
  
**Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:**
Crowe is looking for a Data Solutions Architect to be a leader on our team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience. The primary focus will be helping our clients solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* The shift timings for this role is 5:00PM - 2:00AM IST (7:30AM - 4:30PM ET)
* Serve as subject matter expert on Business Intelligence engineering platforms (Ex - Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Data platform, Snowflake, DBT) demonstrating platform capabilities and promoting application of toolset to address business needs and maximize the value realized from technology investment.
* Oversee the design and deployment of data pipelines, analytics platforms, and reporting frameworks that improve transparency and support decision-making.
* Utilize advanced analytics, machine learning, and statistical modeling techniques to detect anomalous activity and patterns in transaction data.
* Ensure data quality and integrity through best practices in data management and governance.
* Mentor and lead a team of data analysts and consultants, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Provide technical guidance and career development opportunities to junior team members, ensuring high levels of performance and professional growth.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration among teams to integrate data-driven insights into broader business strategies.
* Develop and implement frameworks that align with regulatory changes and help clients stay ahead of compliance requirements.
* Work with legal and compliance teams to translate regulatory requirements into actionable data analytics strategies.
* Contribute to proposals and presentations for potential clients, demonstrating expertise in data analytics and regulatory compliance.
* Represent the organization at industry events and conferences as a subject matter expert in data consulting.
* Drive internal innovation by identifying emerging technologies and methodologies that can improve service delivery.
* Participate in presales engagements to manage the vision and expectations of a client’s multiple stakeholders and create a conceptual solution design involving effort estimation, technical and functional solution, execution methodology, project plan, and team.
* Participate in the systems development process, including planning and monitoring systems development efforts, coordinating activities with other groups, reviewing deliverables and communicating status to the project manager and client.
* Lead and provide technical guidance and mentorship to other team members.
* Architect, implement, deploy, and support analytical databases and pipelines in an Azure environment
* Create proofs of concepts as necessary for architectural vision, strategy, and tool evaluation.
* Document, diagram, and present complex/technical material that can be understood by a non-technical audience.
* Create and deploy accurate client architecture and analyses in a relatively short period of time.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics or a related field is required.
* Advanced degree (Master’s/Ph.D.) is preferred.
* At least 7–10 years of progressive experience in data analytics, consulting, or financial services; a strong background in banking and regulatory compliance implementations is desired.
* Proven track record in managing complex data projects and leading cross-functional teams.
* Experience in working with large datasets, data warehousing, and advanced analytics tools.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise data warehouse and data lake implementations
* 5+ years of external client consulting experience
* 5+ years of hands-on experience building automated ETL/ELT or data integration processes utilizing multiple source systems
* 5+ years of team management experience (including offshore resources)
* 5+ years of experience leading multiple external client projects simultaneously
* 5+ years of preparing detailed external client project budget estimations with strong resource management capabilities
* 3+ years of in-depth experience in architecting, designing, and implementing complex data architectures on Azure including Azure Data Factory, Azure/Managed Instance SQL Server, Azure Logic App, and Azure Synapse Analytics
* Experience mentoring teammates or conducting technical training
* Possess integrity and a strong work ethic
* Strong analytical and verbal/written communication skills

**Certifications (Preferred):**

* Certifications in BI (ETL tools, visualization tools, cloud architectures) are expected
* Certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist), CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), or related data analytics certifications are a plus.

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Experience working in or consulting for financial services clients is highly desirable.
* Hands-on experience with comprehensive dimensional modelling and end-to-end data warehouse projects, including:

+ Requirements gathering
+ Infrastructure planning and deployment
+ Subject matter expert interviews
+ Logical and physical dimensional model design and development
+ ETL/ELT development and maintenance model and data validation
+ Documentation

* Previous consulting experience or experience working with external clients
* Proficiency in analytics and statistical programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL).
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and big data technologies.
* Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and cloud-based data platforms is advantageous
* Experience working on projects using agile development practices
* Azure experience: building landing zones, provisioning resources, establishing security is a big plus

**Key Stakeholders This Role Interacts With:**
**Internal**

* Senior BI Analyst
* Data Product Manager
* BI Architect / Senior Architect
* Data Engineers
* Analytics Developers (Power BI, Tableau)

**External**

* C-Suite Executives (CEO, CFO, CIO, etc.)
* Clients Operations Leads and Mid-Level Managers
* Data Owners, Data Stewards
* Enterprise Information Management and Data Governance Team

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. title: SAP BDC (Business Data Cloud)
description:

- Good understanding of SAP modules and business processes (MM, SD, FI, etc.) and their master/transactional data structures.

- Familiarity with integration patterns involving SAP and cloud-based data platforms.

- ABAP debugging and troubleshooting skills.

- Strong documentation and stakeholder collaboration skills.

- 4+ years of experience in SAP ABAP with strong BDC expertise

- Hands-on experience with SHDB recordings and BDC program development

- Strong understanding of SAP ECC processes (FI/MM/SD preferred)

- Experience handling large-scale data uploads and migrations

- Good debugging and performance optimization skills in ABAP

- Ability to work with functional consultants and business users

**Good to Have**

- Exposure to S/4HANA data migration projects Knowledge of BAPIs, IDOCs, LSMW, or SAP Migration Cockpit Experience working alongside data platforms like Azure, Microsoft Fabric, or Data

Lakes Understanding of SAP integration and modernization strategies

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting - Senior:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Join a high-performing SAP Analytics and Data team to help organizations unlock business value through data-driven insights. As an SAP BDC Consultant, you will work on designing, developing, and implementing enterprise data and analytics solutions using SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and related technologies. You will collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable, innovative, and high-quality data solutions that support strategic decision-making.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, and SAP BW/4HANA data models.
* Gather and analyse business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Build and optimize data pipelines, transformations, and integration processes.
* Develop analytical models, reports, and dashboards using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
* Integrate SAP and non-SAP data sources to support enterprise analytics requirements.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities.
* Support data governance, security, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with business users, architects, and project teams throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Troubleshoot performance issues and optimize data models and reporting solutions.
* Prepare technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support teams.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of SAP Datasphere, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP HANA, and SAP Business Data Cloud concepts.
* Experience in data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, and data warehousing principles.
* Knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) reporting and planning capabilities.
* Understanding of SAP S/4HANA data structures and analytical content.
* Experience with SQL, SAP HANA modelling, and data integration techniques.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in Agile delivery methodologies.
* Customer-focused mindset with attention to detail and quality.

**<< Ideally, you’ll also>>**

* SAP certifications in Datasphere, BW/4HANA, SAC, or related SAP technologies.
* Exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, or other SAP functional domains.

**<< What we look for>>**
We are looking for motivated professionals who are passionate about data, analytics, and digital transformation. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical expertise, a continuous learning mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams to deliver business value through innovative SAP data and analytics solutions. title: Technical Implementation Manager
description:
At Landis+Gyr, we're helping shape the future of energy—making it more intelligent, resilient, and sustainable.
  
  
As a global energy technology leader, we're accelerating the energy evolution through purposeful innovation and trusted partnerships. Trusted by more than 2,000 utilities worldwide, our intelligent solutions connect devices, data, and decisions across the grid, helping customers modernize infrastructure, optimize operations, and deliver energy that is more reliable, resilient, accessible, safe, and sustainable.
  
  
Behind every solution is a team of approximately 3,300 employees across more than 40 countries who are passionate about solving complex challenges, driving innovation, and making a meaningful impact for our utility customers and the communities they serve.
  
  
Join Team Green and help shape the future of intelligent energy.
  
  
**Technical Implementation Manager**
The Technical Implementation Manager (TIM) owns the technical delivery of Landis+Gyr's AMI products and solutions for new customer deployments and upgrades. The role covers both containerized deployments on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE), delivered using CI/CD pipelines and automation, and multi-tier deployments of the Head-End System (HES) across Windows and Linux servers. Across both, the TIM takes the Landis+Gyr solution from environment readiness through to production, covering the full stack from head-end software to field network endpoints.
  
  
Working closely with Program Managers, infrastructure teams, customer IT and operations teams, and Landis+Gyr engineering and product groups, the TIM is accountable for a successful go-live. This includes resolving technical issues that arise during deployment and the hypercare period, and transitioning the solution smoothly to the support organization. The role calls for deep hands-on DevOps expertise and a strong working knowledge of GCP, combined with the planning and customer-facing skills needed to deliver complex deployments on schedule.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end technical deployment of Landis+Gyr AMI solutions for new customers and upgrades, from environment readiness through go-live, planning activities with Program Managers and managing dependencies and risks.
* Validate that provisioned GCP and RKE environments meet deployment prerequisites, working with the infrastructure teams responsible for provisioning them.
* Deploy, configure and upgrade containerized applications on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE) using Docker and Helm charts.
* Install, configure and upgrade the Head-End System (HES) across its multi-tier architecture (network, metrology, web, application and adapter tiers) on Windows and Linux servers, including IIS and .NET-based components.
* Use and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or similar) and scripting (PowerShell, Bash) to automate deployment, upgrade and rollback, and build reusable deployment templates across customers.
* Set up monitoring, logging and alerting so deployed applications are production-ready at go-live.
* Deliver integrations between the Landis+Gyr head-end and customer enterprise systems (e.g., MDM, CIS).
* Lead System Acceptance Testing (SAT) for new deployments and upgrades, driving defects to resolution.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during deployment and hypercare through root cause analysis, engaging engineering, product, infrastructure and support teams as needed.
* Manage the formal handover to support teams, including operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
* Follow formal change control processes and keep ServiceNow records complete for deployment-phase changes and issues.
* Act as the customer's technical point of contact, leading technical workshops and liaising across Landis+Gyr business units throughout the deployment.

**Key Competencies**

* Automation-first mindset, making every deployment repeatable, version-controlled and scripted
* Proven ownership of complex deployments end to end, from planning through go-live
* Strong planning and prioritization skills across parallel workstreams
* Methodical analytical and troubleshooting skills, with sound technical judgment
* Clear, confident communicator with customer technical teams, both written and verbal
* Self-starter who works independently, collaborates across teams and performs under time pressure
* Willingness to travel to customer sites (~50%)

**Technical Skills**
**Required:**

* Kubernetes: deploying and managing production workloads on GKE and RKE (Rancher Kubernetes Engine)
* Containers and packaging: Docker, Helm charts
* CI/CD: working with and maintaining pipelines in Jenkins or similar tools
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP): strong working knowledge of core services, as a user of GCP-hosted environments
* Infrastructure as code: working knowledge of Terraform
* Scripting and automation: PowerShell, Bash
* Version control: Git
* Operating systems: Linux/Unix and Microsoft Windows Server, for application deployment
* Databases: Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL
* Networking: IP suite and wireless/RF/broadband communication technologies
* IIS and .NET Framework

**Preferred:**

* Monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
* Hardware Security Modules (HSM) and load balancers
* Two-way AMI technology, from head-end software to field endpoints

**Qualifications – Education And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication, Computer Science or IT
* 10+ years of industry experience, including at least 6 years in DevOps, cloud-based or technical deployment roles
* Experience deploying multi-tier enterprise applications on Windows and Linux server environments
* Experience delivering solutions that combine software and hardware
* Customer-facing experience, including independent travel to customer sites
* Energy utility or AMI operations experience is a plus

We value and encourage diversity in our team. This position is open to all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, or background. We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone. Join Team Green and be part of what's next in energy.
**#TeamGreen**

title: Snowflake Engineer
description:
**ole Overview**

The Data Warehouse Engineer serves as the primary technical lead for the Snowflake data warehousing ecosystem. This role is responsible for designing scalable data models, managing Snowflake environments, optimizing performance and cost, enforcing security policies, and supporting analytics and enterprise reporting platforms, including Business Objects (BIC), across the organization. The DW Engineer ensures that Snowflake is stable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards, and collaborates with Platform Administrators and third‑party vendors to ensure reporting platform uptime and timely escalation of issues impacting reporting availability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Modeling & Architecture**

* Design enterprise‑level Snowflake models including conformed dimensions, fact tables, and semantic views.
* Document ERDs, modeling assumptions, and physical/logical architectures.
* Establish and enforce modeling standards, naming conventions, and performance optimization patterns.

**Transformation & Automation**

* Build advanced SQL transformations across all Snowflake layers.
* Implement automated workflows using Tasks, Streams, procedures, and time‑based orchestration.
* Support schema evolution and large‑scale data integration patterns.

**Environment & Release Management**

* Coordinate Snowflake schema and object deployments via Git or CI/CD pipelines.
* Own release readiness for Snowflake across Dev, Test, and Prod.
* Ensure new models, views, RBAC changes, and stored procedures are validated prior to promotion.

**Performance Optimization**

* Conduct performance tuning through micro‑partition analysis, clustering, query plan reviews, and caching strategies.
* Implement Resource Monitors, usage alerts, and proactive performance dashboards.
* Review warehouse utilization to ensure compute resources are right‑sized and cost‑optimized.

**Security, RBAC & Controls**

* Design and maintain Snowflake role hierarchies, object privileges, row‑level security, and masking policies.
* Support audit requests, compliance checks, and evidence gathering for reviews.
* Govern secure internal and external data sharing.

**Cost Management**

* Produce recurring consumption reports to support conduct cost optimization analysis.
* Recommend improvements in warehouse sizing, retention policies, storage optimization, and compute scheduling.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Work with Data Engineers to coordinate ingestion design, transformation logic, and schema updates.
* Partner with BI teams to optimize datasets for Power BI, Qlik, and analytical tools.
* Align with Platform Administrators on environment setup, migrations, and operational readiness.

**Documentation & Governance**

* Maintain transformation specifications, lineage, and architectural diagrams.
* Ensure models and pipelines comply with governance policies and development standards.

**Enterprise Operational Reporting Platform (Web Intelligence)**

* Collaborate with Platform Administrators and the vendor to ensure reporting platform uptime and timely escalation of reporting issues.

**Skills & Tools Requirements**

* **Snowflake SQL**
  : 5+ years of advanced SQL development experience, including complex query optimization, data modeling, performance tuning, and ETL/ELT development within Snowflake environments.
* **Snowflake Administration**
  : 3+ years of hands-on experience administering Snowflake platforms, including security, role-based access control (RBAC), warehouse management, monitoring, performance optimization, and cost governance.
* **dbt (Data Build Tool)**
  : 4+ years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data transformation frameworks using dbt, including testing, documentation, and CI/CD integration.
* **Git / Version Control**
  : 5+ years of experience using Git-based source control systems (GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket) for collaborative development, branching strategies, code reviews, and release management.
* **CI/CD Pipelines & Deployment Automation**
  : 5+ years of experience implementing and supporting CI/CD pipelines for data warehouse and analytics deployments, including automated testing, code promotion, release management, and deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent platforms
* **Financial services experience**
  : Preferred.
* **Business Objects (SAP BO/Web Intelligence)**
  : Preferred.

The organization provides full-stack talent management solutions for innovative companies, using specialized platforms to support hackathons, research projects, and hiring campaigns. Academic institutions benefit from an AI-based marketplace that surfaces opportunities for contractual research, technology transfer, and talent engagement. Students and working professionals can access gamified experiences, including hackathons and job challenges, to build skills and advance their careers. The platform is focused on innovation, engineering, technology, and career development within a collaborative ecosystem.
  
**Role Description**
The SQL Instructor will deliver structured, hands-on training in SQL and related database concepts to learners at various proficiency levels. This full-time, on-site role is based in Noida and involves designing curriculum, preparing lesson plans, and creating practical exercises, projects, and assessments aligned with industry expectations. The instructor will conduct classroom sessions, provide one-on-one support, review assignments, and offer feedback to help learners build strong data skills. The role includes collaborating with internal teams to integrate SQL learning paths into hackathons and hiring campaigns, updating course content based on emerging technologies, and maintaining accurate records of learner performance. The SQL Instructor is also expected to participate in workshops, demo sessions, and outreach events to promote data literacy and engagement on the Where U Elevate® platform.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in SQL and relational database concepts, including querying, joins, indexing, and optimization.
* Experience with at least one major database system (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle) and basic knowledge of data modeling.
* Demonstrated teaching, training, or mentoring experience, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to diverse audiences.
* Curriculum design and content development skills for creating structured lessons, exercises, and assessments.
* Comfort with using digital tools and learning platforms to deliver and track training programs.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with a learner-centered and inclusive approach.
* Ability to work on-site in Noida, manage classroom dynamics, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; relevant certifications in SQL or databases are an advantage.
* Familiarity with analytics, programming (such as Python or R), or AI-driven learning platforms is beneficial.

The Engineering Manager – Data Management is accountable for leading teams responsible for delivering platform changes, upgrades, and continuous improvements across enterprise data management products and customer environments. This role ensures changes are delivered safely, predictably, and in compliance, while scaling engineering excellence through strong people leadership, governance, and adoption of data-driven and AI-enabled practices.

**Change, Upgrade & Release Ownership**

* Own end-to-end delivery of data management changes, upgrades, and major releases across environments.
* Ensure all changes follow approved change management, validation, and rollback frameworks.
* Accountable for release readiness, production stability, and post-release outcomes.

**Data Platform & Engineering Oversight**

**Risk, Compliance & Governance**

**People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead and develop engineering, QA, and release/change professionals.
* Drive performance management, career growth, mentoring, and succession planning.
* Foster a culture of accountability, quality, continuous improvement, and psychological safety.

**Stakeholder & Customer Alignment**

* Partner with product, operations, compliance, and customer-facing teams to align priorities.
* Communicate change scope, risks, timelines, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders.
* Support escalations with data-driven analysis, corrective actions, and preventive improvements.

**Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Continuously improve change, release, and validation processes to reduce defects and recovery time.
* Promote standardization, automation, and repeatability in upgrade execution.
* Track delivery and operational metrics to improve predictability and quality.

**Required Experience & Capabilities**

* Proven experience managing engineering teams in complex, data-centric environments.
* Strong understanding of data platforms, releases, and change governance.
* Demonstrated ability to balance technical depth, people leadership, and stakeholder management.
* Experience applying automation and AI-assisted practices in engineering or operations is a strong advantage.

**What We Value**

* 14–15 years of overall software engineering experience with significant time in .NET/C# ecosystems.
* 5+ years leading engineers (direct people leadership), owning delivery and engineering standards.
* Proven ability to work effectively in large, distributed, international organizations and across levels.

**Technical Experience**

* NET / C# Core Expertise

Strong C# fundamentals and deep experience with Microsoft .NET Framework, including emphasis on:
  
  

* WPF, WCF, WWF
* Strong understanding of async programming, concurrency, and performance considerations

**Modern Services & Cloud-native**
Strong experience with Web API, .NET Core, and modern architecture patterns:
  
  

* Microservices
* Docker / container-based applications

**Azure DevOps Pipelines**

* Hands-on experience designing and operating Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, including quality gates and release orchestration.

**Code Reviews & Engineering Standards**

* Demonstrated ability to drive high-quality, efficient code reviews, enforce standards, and mentor engineers.

**Code Optimization / Performance Engineering**

* Proven track record in profiling and code optimization strategies

**Multi-threaded / Performance-intensive Systems**

* Experience building and operating multi-threaded, performance intensive applications, with strong understanding of concurrency patterns and pitfalls.

**Source Control & Continuous Build**

* Strong experience with Git/TFS, branching, PR workflows, and continuous builds integrated into CI/CD.

**AI Elements (Required Mindset + Practical Application)**

* To align with SimCorp’s emphasis on engineering excellence and scalable delivery, we expect the Engineering Manager to lead responsible adoption of AI-assisted practices in day-to-day engineering

**AI-assisted Engineering Productivity (Developer Experience)**

* Establish team practices for AI-assisted coding (e.g., suggestions, refactoring support, unit-test generation assistance) with clear review accountability and secure usage patterns.
* Build “definition of done” expectations for AI-assisted output (tests, security checks, performance impact review, documentation).

**AI for Quality, Risk & Reliability:**
Use AI-assisted approaches to improve:
  
  

* test prioritization and regression optimization
* anomaly detection in logs/telemetry
* root-cause analysis acceleration during incidents
* knowledge search across engineering artifacts (runbooks, RCA history, design notes)

**Domain Experience (Strong Plus):**

* Experience in Capital Markets is a plus, preferably with Buy-Side firms (asset managers, pension funds, investment managers), and understanding of data workflows typical in investment operations and analytics.

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
* Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually

title: Digital Systems Lead – Construction Site Apps
description:
About us

KV Developers is part of ReaRCo, a restructuring and turnaround group that works on practical solutions to real-world problems. We are building a technology-driven construction company and are developing a range of in-house digital tools for our projects, starting at our residential project in Greater Noida West.

About the role

Our site already runs on in-house mobile apps for snagging and de-snagging of flats, daily monitoring of works, labour and contractors, and reports for management, built on Google Workspace and AppSheet with scripted automation. More tools will follow.

We are looking for one person to own the day-to-day running of these apps: making changes, keeping the data clean, testing before release, training site staff and contractors, and making sure the apps are actually used on site. You will work directly with the founder and the project leadership. Most technical design and coding is prepared with AI tools; your job is to turn decisions into working, well-tested tools quickly and get them adopted on site.

What you will do

- Configure and release changes to the apps (AppSheet) and their data (Google Sheets); keep a change log.

- Own master data: users and logins, roles, contractors, locations, work items and assignments.

- Test every change on a test copy before release, and run field tests with site teams.

- Train engineers, foremen, contractors and vendors in Hindi and English, and follow up until the apps are used daily.

- Track adoption and data quality, and send a short written summary each evening.

- Collect feedback from site and management into one list, and prepare specifications with AI tools for decisions.

- Act as second administrator for Google Workspace and related accounts; keep access, backups and documentation in order.

- Support a planned move of the data to a SQL database with a senior technical reviewer.

What we are looking for

- 4 to 8 years in residential or commercial construction as a civil, QA/QC or planning engineer, or a no-code developer with real site exposure.

- Confident with Google Sheets and at least one no-code or low-code tool (AppSheet preferred); able to read simple scripts.

- Comfortable working with AI tools (for example ChatGPT or Claude) to draft, check and document work.

- Methodical about testing, data and documentation.

- Fluent in Hindi and English; able to train site staff and hold contractors to a routine.

- Discreet with confidential data and systems.

Good to have: Apps Script or JavaScript, SQL, Looker Studio, MS Project or Primavera, experience rolling out a site app or ERP module.

Location and hours: at our site in Greater Noida West, Monday to Saturday; hybrid once the rollout settles.

Reports to: the founder, working closely with the project head on site and the planning head.

Compensation: competitive, in line with experience.

To apply: please include one example of a tool, app, sheet or process you built or rolled out, and what changed as a result.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart(R).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Principal Consultant to join our team. As a consultant, you will provide strategic guidance and technical expertise to drive the success of our Drug Safety consulting operations. This position plays a key role in delivering innovative pharmacovigilance solutions, ensuring regulatory compliance, and advancing patient safety across complex global engagements. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, and contribute to client success from project planning through implementation and closeout. Responsibilities include leading solution design and implementation, mentoring technical teams, and ensuring adherence to industry best practices and Parexel methodologies.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through innovative pharmacovigilance solutions and client-centric delivery. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Pharmacovigilance Consulting Services Lead can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research, drug safety, and enterprise technology solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze business needs and provide strategic guidance to ensure drug safety solutions meet customer objectives and drive successful project outcomes
* Lead solution design and implementation for client engagements, ensuring high-quality, integrated software solutions delivered within project constraints of time and budget
* Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader, providing technical expertise in drug safety systems including Veeva Systems, Insight, Mart, Analytics, OBIEE, and Axway EDI platforms
* Manage and mentor a team of technical consultants and developers, providing coaching, guidance, and feedback to develop team member skills and drive project success
* Present and demonstrate solutions to customers, influencing customer management in acceptance of solutions and ensuring successful business implementation
* Apply hands-on technical expertise in SQL and PL/SQL with strong troubleshooting skills across Veeva Systems, Axway, and associated modules to resolve complex technical challenges

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strategic thinking and technical leadership capabilities to guide complex drug safety implementations
* Deep experience in drug safety systems, implementation methodologies, and best practices
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL programming skills with excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
* Proven ability to lead teams, mentor consultants, and collaborate effectively across organizations
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholder decisions

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's / master’s degree in computer science, information technology, or any engineering degree
* 8+ years of experience relevant to this position, including 5 years of consulting experience in drug safety or clinical research
* Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
* Experience with pharmacovigilance platforms such as Veeva Systems, Insight, Mart, or similar systems
* Extensive knowledge of writing SQL queries and PL/SQL code
* In-depth knowledge of drug safety application implementation, upgrade, and maintenance
* Ability to craft and articulate strategic technology solutions that address complex business challenges

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with E2B(R3) or EDI protocols for adverse event reporting
* Familiarity with additional pharmacovigilance analytics and visualization tools
* Experience in consulting or client-facing roles within the pharmaceutical industry

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Application Engineer - III**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.
* Translates technical specifications into code for complex new or enhancement projects for internal clients. Writes programs, develops code, tests artifacts, and produces reports. Employs software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that support automation.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
* Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Backup, Recovery and Disaster Recovery Own backup and recovery using open-source PostgreSQL tools such as pgBackRest, Barman, or WAL-G. Design and test disaster recovery (DR) and high availability (HA) setups using Patroni and Data Guard. Own Recovery Point Objective (RPO) and Recovery Time Objective (RTO) targets and failover runbooks. CDC and Migration Configure and troubleshoot Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines using Debezium, Striim, or GoldenGate. Apply working knowledge of Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration, including schema conversion, query rewrites, and cutover planning. Automation and CI/CD Automate routine operations using Python, Shell, or Ansible. Build and maintain database CI/CD processes, including version-controlled schema changes and automated migration pipelines using Liquibase or Flyway. Monitoring and Observability Build and maintain database monitoring and observability using pgBadger, OEM, and Prometheus/Grafana. Tune alerting thresholds to identify problems early. Security Implement encryption at rest and in transit, access control, and auditing across both database platforms. Architecture and Mentorship Own architecture decisions independently. Mentor junior DBAs. Communicate risks and trade-offs clearly to leadership and other teams. Production Support Participate in the on-call rotation for critical incidents outside regular working hours. Required Skills 7–10 years of DBA experience, with strong PostgreSQL expertise and solid Oracle knowledge, including RAC, ASM, and Data Guard. Working knowledge of Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration. Hands-on experience with CDC tools; Debezium is preferred. Experience with backup and recovery using open-source PostgreSQL tools. Experience in DR/HA design and conducting actual drills, not just theoretical knowledge. Strong performance tuning skills (non-negotiable) and partitioning expertise. Understanding of database security and encryption. Experience with database CI/CD and schema version control. Experience with monitoring and observability tools. Scripting experience in Python or Shell. Strong communication skills, with a track record of mentoring and owning architecture decisions. Preferred Experience BFSI or fintech experience is preferred. Nice to Have Exposure to cloud-hosted databases. Experience on an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration project. Familiarity with database activity monitoring tools such as Guardium.
  
  
**Required Skills**
['PostgreSQL', 'Oracle', 'Query Tuning', 'Index Tuning', 'Partitioning', 'Backup and Recovery', 'DR/HA Setups', 'CDC Pipelines', 'Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Migration', 'Automation']
