title: Senior Database Administrator
description: About UsAt apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/Job DetailsThe Role -We are seeking a motivated and detail‑oriented Database Administrator (DBA) with 4 - 10 years of proven hands‑on experience in Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL). You will support the design, implementation, operations, and continuous improvement of mission‑critical SQL Server databases. The role requires solid skills in performance tuning, high availability, backup & recovery, and security hardening, working within a collaborative production environment and contributing to team standards and best practices. As the team expands its use of OceanBase and PostgreSQL, the ideal candidate will bring a strong willingness to learn these platforms and support migrations from SQL Server.The Work - Database Implementation and Support Install, configure, and manage the lifecycle of SQL Server instances (standalone, clustered, and Always On) across environments. Contribute to database architecture decisions (storage layout, file/filegroup design, instance sizing) across dev/QA/prod. Design and deploy schema objects (tables, views, stored procedures, functions), following standards and participating in code reviews. Implement and maintain configuration baselines (e.g., max server memory, MAXDOP, cost threshold for parallelism, TempDB layout).High Availability & Disaster Recovery Implement and operate SQL Server HA/DR solutions including Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, and Log Shipping. Maintain DR runbooks and support RTO/RPO targets; participate in planned failover and disaster recovery testing. Monitor AG synchronization health, cluster resources, and quorum configuration; troubleshoot failover events. Regularly test backups and end‑to‑end recovery (database‑level, point‑in‑time, and site failover).Monitoring and Alerting Set up proactive alerting for blocking, deadlocks, long‑running queries, failed jobs, AG latency, and disk space. Configure and tune monitoring for wait stats, TempDB health, I/O latency, index fragmentation, and blocking chains. Analyze metrics, logs, and execution plans to derive actionable insights and support incident response.Capacity Planning Track storage, compute, and connection usage, and forecast capacity based on growth patterns and workload characteristics. Perform index and data growth analysis, and recommend cost‑efficient scaling approaches.Backup and Recovery Operations Implement and automate SQL Server backup strategies (full/differential/transaction log) using native tools or Ola Hallengren maintenance solutions. Validate restores regularly through automated restore drills and DBCC CHECKDB integrity checks. Document recovery playbooks and ensure compliance with RPO/RTO objectives.Performance Tuning Tune SQL Server workloads using execution plans, Query Store, DMVs, Extended Events, and statistics maintenance. Optimize indexing strategy, mitigate parameter sniffing, and tune memory/parallelism settings; apply plan forcing when appropriate. Define performance baselines; guide developers on query design and access patterns.Security and Access Control Implement least‑privilege access, role‑based security, password policies/secrets management, encryption (TDE/Always Encrypted), and auditing for SQL Server. Support audit/compliance requirements and periodic access reviews. Patching and Updates Plan and execute SQL Server CU/version upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime. Evaluate new SQL Server features and recommend adoption where relevant. Support database migrations from SQL Server to OceanBase or PostgreSQL, including schema and code conversion, data movement, cutover planning, and post‑migration validation.Incident Handling Troubleshoot and perform root‑cause analysis for performance, availability, and data integrity incidents. Contribute to post‑incident reviews and implement preventative measures. Automation and Scripting Automate routine operations using T‑SQL, PowerShell (e.g., dbatools), SQL Agent jobs, and, where applicable, Python. Use AI‑assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot or LLM‑based assistants) to accelerate scripting, query analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation, applying sound judgment to validate outputs. Support version control and CI/CD practices for database code and configuration.Team Collaboration Partner with application, platform, and infrastructure teams to align database designs with product goals. Review schema changes, migration scripts, and data movement; share knowledge with junior team members.Assist in Migrations Knowledge of PostgreSQL and/or OceanBase, or experience migrating workloads from SQL Server to either platform, is an added advantage. Demonstrate eagerness and ability to learn new database platforms; candidates should be willing to build hands‑on skills in PostgreSQL and OceanBase.The Must-Haves - Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.Experience 4-10 years of hands‑on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server in production environments. Hands‑on experience with HA/DR (Always On AG, FCI), performance tuning, and backup/recovery for business‑critical systems.Additional Skills (Preferred) Familiarity with SSIS, SSRS, or other SQL Server BI/ETL components. Scripting/automation using Bash, PowerShell, or Python; CI/CD/GitOps practices. Practical use of AI tools for DBA work, such as AI‑assisted T‑SQL and script authoring, query and execution‑plan analysis, log/incident triage, and documentation.Certifications Microsoft (e.g., Azure/SQL) or equivalent (optional but preferred). Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP‑300) is a plus.Communication Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to document processes, participate in technical discussions, and work effectively within a team.Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/BenefitsAt apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer – HBase
description:
**Role: Senior Data Platform Engineer – HBase, EMR & Spark Modernization**

**Project Role:**
Data Engineer – HBase/EMR/Spark

**Location:**
Hybrid – India

Summary of the Role

We are looking for a “Senior Data Platform Engineer” with strong hands-on experience in
**HBase, Amazon EMR, Hadoop, and Spark**
to support a production data platform modernisation and migration programme.

The role will focus on migrating and modernising distributed data platforms while maintaining application compatibility, data integrity, performance, and operational stability. The ideal candidate must have real production experience operating and migrating
**HBase/EMR environments**
, not only experience with Spark, Databricks, or ETL development.

The engineer will participate in migration planning, cluster-level troubleshooting, data validation, snapshot/restore activities, cutover, rollback, and post-migration verification.

Responsibilities

* Design and execute migration and modernization activities for
  **HBase, EMR, Hadoop, and Spark**
  environments.
* Support production migration of HBase/EMR workloads across environments.
* Perform cluster-level troubleshooting and resolve performance, availability, and compatibility issues.
* Plan and execute

  .

  **Snapshot/ExportSnapshot/HFile**

* Support
  **EMR version upgrades and platform modernization**
  .

* Troubleshoot migration issues involving data integrity, cluster configuration, application connectivity, performance, and compatibility.
* Work with Backend, Cloud, Architect, DevSecOps, Security, and QA teams to resolve cross-platform dependencies.
* Support data validation and reconciliation between legacy and target environments.
* Document migration procedures, validation results, issues, resolutions, and operational runbooks.
* Contribute to automation and repeatable processes for migration and validation activities.

Must-Have Skills

* **5+ years**
  of experience in Data Engineering / Big Data Engineering.
* Strong hands-on production experience with
  **HBase**
  .
* Strong experience with
  **Amazon EMR**
  .
* Strong experience with
  **Apache Spark**
  .
* Strong understanding of
  **Hadoop**
  ecosystem.
* Experience with
  **Scala and/or Spark programming**
  .

  **S3**
  and AWS-based data platforms.
* Hands-on experience with
  **HBase/EMR migration or modernization**
  .
* Experience with production data migration and
  **cutover activities**
  .
* Experience validating migrated data through
  **row/region counts, reconciliation, checksums, or equivalent validation techniques**
  .
* Experience troubleshooting distributed data platforms at the cluster level.
* Strong understanding of dependencies between HBase, Spark, Hadoop, and application workloads.
* Experience with production support and migration-related troubleshooting.

Good-to-Have Skills

title: Senior Associate - Implementation Specialist
description:
**About Us**
At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.
  
  
And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.
  
  
Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/
  
  
WORK LOCATION – Noida, Sector -135, Candor Tech space
  
  
WORK TIMINGS - 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM (IST)
  
  
**Position Summary**
****Transportation will be given by company****
The Sr. Associate – Implementation Specialist provides technical leadership and hands-on expertise across client implementations of apex portal™ and smartVM™. The role owns the technical success of an implementation end to end — from requirement discovery and solution design through ERP integration, data mapping, testing and go-live.
  
  
The successful candidate combines strong technical depth in SaaS platforms, APIs, ETL and databases with the consulting presence to build trusted client relationships. Practical, hands-on experience applying AI tools within a delivery or implementation environment is mandatory for this role. This is also a mentoring role: you will guide junior team members and act as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Client Implementation & Delivery****
▪ Identify critical implementation requirements and build an implementation plan that delivers project milestones on time and to scope.
  
  
▪ Present technical overviews of apexportal and associated technical requirements to clients during implementation and upgrade planning.
  
  
▪ Manage the setup and configuration of the technical environment for hosted clients.
  
  
▪ Take end-to-end ownership of release and delivery activities, including cutover and post go-live stabilization.
  
  
****Solution Design & Integration****
▪ Design and develop workflows for apexportal functionality and present them to key stakeholders for sign-off.
  
  
▪ Assist clients in designing and building interfaces between their ERP systems and apexportal, and lead the testing of those integrations, including data reconciliation between the client ERP and apexportal.
  
  
▪ Develop and unit test baseline modules of the apexportal Solutions product.
  
  
▪ Apply AI tools and automation to accelerate delivery tasks such as data mapping, configuration, testing, documentation and issue diagnosis.
  
  
****Technical Leadership & Support****
▪ Serve as Subject Matter Expert and technical lead for client configurations and installations of apexportal and smartVM.
  
  
▪ Act as the escalation point for internal and external deployments, troubleshooting and diagnosing the root cause of software issues.
  
  
▪ Provide guidance, training and knowledge transfer to junior team members across both products.
  
  
▪ Partner with the Client Value and Audit teams to resolve client issues and support ongoing accounts.
  
  
****Process Improvement & Reporting****
▪ Design, implement and enhance high-impact business process improvement initiatives for client software implementations.
  
  
▪ Create and maintain mockups, BRDs, FRDs and wireframes using tools such as Visio, Excel, Microsoft Project, Adobe and Snagit.
  
  
▪ Provide recommendations to leadership on a regular and ad-hoc basis and prepare periodic status reporting for management.
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
**Candidates must demonstrate all of the following:**
▪
****AI experience —****
hands-on experience applying AI tools and technologies (for example AI-assisted development, automation, document or data extraction, or AI-supported analysis) to real delivery work. Candidates should be able to describe specific use cases and the outcome achieved.
  
  
▪
****Implementation / ERP background —****
4+ years in an implementation, technical consulting or professional services role, including exposure to ERP systems and their data structures.
  
  
▪
****SaaS product understanding —****
solid understanding of SaaS architecture, multi-tenant delivery models, configuration-led implementations and the release cycles they operate on.
  
  
▪
****APIs, ETL & data warehousing —****
working knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, ETL mapping and table design, and core data warehouse concepts.
  
  
▪
****Database skills —****
hands-on experience with SQL Server, PostgreSQL or an equivalent relational database, including the ability to write and troubleshoot complex queries, stored procedures, views, indexes and jobs (2+ years).
  
  
▪
****Communication —****
excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to present technical concepts to non-technical client stakeholders and executives.
  
  
▪
****Delivery methodology —****
4+ years delivering within Agile / Scrum SDLC environments.
  
  
**Additional Technical Skills**
▪ Experience with Supply Chain or Procure-to-Pay technology implementations.
  
  
▪ Working knowledge of integration technologies including SSO, SAML, SSL, web services, REST and SOAP; ServiceNow integration experience is an advantage.
  
  
▪ Experience with version control tools such as Git, SVN, CVS or TFS.
  
  
▪ Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, QlikView or SSRS.
  
  
▪ Comfortable working with the command line and standard system commands.
  
  
**Preferred / Good To Have**
▪ Hands-on experience with Workday or Oracle.
  
  
▪ Consulting experience across multiple ERPs — specifically MDM, Vendor Master and P2P (SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft and similar).
  
  
▪ Exposure to Accounts Payable modules within ERP systems such as Workday, SAP, Oracle or J.D. Edwards.
  
  
▪ Knowledge of report migration, subscriptions and data extraction from ERP systems.
  
  
▪ Experience defining application and system configuration standards with cross-functional teams and business units.
  
  
****CORE COMPETENCIES****
▪ Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with a track record of diagnosing root causes rather than symptoms.
  
  
▪ Client-service mindset, with the ability to translate client requirements into automated, scalable solutions.
  
  
▪ Highly organized and detail-oriented; able to multi-task with limited supervision and meet changing deadlines under pressure.
  
  
▪ Takes initiative and accepts accountability for outcomes.
  
  
▪ Collaborative and willing to share knowledge across the team.
  
  
**About Apexanalytix**
apexanalytix is a cloud-based software and services company that works with over 200 of the Global Fortune 1000 to recover lost profits, protect against procurement fraud, and manage supplier onboarding, compliance and payment profit optimization. Each year we receive approximately 9 million supplier records and $4.6 trillion in invoices and payments from our clients. We work with organizations including the world's largest retailer, electronics company, entertainment company, financial institutions, pharmaceutical and automotive manufacturers, and services companies, with shared services locations in the US, UK and Hong Kong.
  
  
Delivering our solutions to the world’s largest companies has enabled us to build what a leading IT industry analyst describes as possibly the only trusted source for accurate, high-value supplier information. We are making this data available to solution developers, enterprises and other organizations through an on-demand API business model. Our API service to the validated and enhanced smartVM data source is supplemented by over 400 real-time data sources through direct integration, subscription and robotics — giving clients the trusted data they need to ensure compliance, manage risk, improve B2B transaction processing, enable strategic initiatives, predict outcomes and prescribe action.
  
  
**apexanalytix is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or any other protected status.**

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Senior Consultant \- Disaster Recovery (Database)
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 At EY, our Consulting practice combines strategy, technology, and operations to help clients modernize, optimize, and build resilient database platforms. You will work with global clients to design, implement, and support mission\-critical database environments while enabling cloud transformation, high availability, and disaster recovery capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Engage with clients to understand business and recovery requirements and translate them into database solutions.
* Provide advisory on database modernization, cloud adoption, HA, and DR strategies.
* Design, implement, and manage Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and other database platforms.
* Perform installation, upgrades, migrations, patching, and performance tuning.
* Manage backup, recovery, high availability, security, and disaster recovery solutions.
* Configure and support Data Guard, Always\-On, replication, clustering, log shipping, and similar technologies.
* Develop and maintain DR plans, recovery runbooks, recovery procedures, and supporting documentation.
* Participate in DR assessments, DR drills, failover testing, and recovery readiness validation.
* Support cloud migration initiatives, including DR architecture and recovery design.
* Troubleshoot complex database, failover, and recovery issues.
* Develop HA/DR frameworks, best practices, accelerators, and reusable assets.
* Support proposal development, solutioning, and client presentations.


**Requirements**
* 5\-8 years of database administration and engineering experience.
* Strong expertise in Oracle and/or Microsoft SQL Server.
* Good understanding of HA, DR, backup/recovery, and operational resilience concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with Data Guard, Always\-On, replication, clustering, log shipping, and other DR technologies.
* Experience developing DR plans, recovery runbooks, recovery procedures, and supporting DR testing and validation activities.
* Exposure to enterprise BCP/DR programs, recovery exercises, failover testing, and resilience assessments.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or cloud\-native databases is preferred.
* Knowledge of Linux/Windows, virtualization, storage, and compute infrastructure.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP and DR\-aware cloud architectures.
* Knowledge of Shell, PowerShell, or Python scripting.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and client\-facing skills.


**What We Offer**
 Opportunity to work on large\-scale database transformation, cloud, resilience, and disaster recovery programs for global clients, with continuous learning, career growth, and exposure to leading technologies and consulting engagements.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

As an award\-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting\-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people\-first culture.
   

  

 With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end\-to\-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile \& Digital Marketing \| Enterprise AI \| Customer Care AI \& Technology \| Enterprise Technology Modernization
   

  

 From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in\-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi\-billion\-dollar parent company.
   

  

**Location \& Flexibility**
**India Hybrid: Noida, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram**
 This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Noida/Bengaluru (1 to 2 times/ week). Our office culture is designed to foster in\-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 TELUS Digital is seeking an experienced SAP Technical lead to join our team. As an SAP Technical Lead , you will be responsible for performing SAP technical administration, monitoring, troubleshooting integration issues, controlling transport movements, overseeing quarterly technical upgrades, and overseeing identity and access management activities. You will leverage your strong skills in SAP Public Cloud, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), and deep technical knowledge to diagnose and resolve technical issues in the SAP system and integrated third\-party systems such as Salesforce, Replicon, and SAP SuccessFactors.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Perform SAP technical administration tasks, including system configuration, monitoring, and performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot integration issues between SAP and third\-party systems, such as Salesforce, Replicon, and SAP SuccessFactors.
* Monitor system interfaces and integration points, ensuring smooth data flow and resolving any data inconsistencies or errors.
* Control transport movements, including transporting SAP objects across different system landscapes and ensuring proper release management processes.
* Lead technical upgrades, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to plan and execute the upgrade activities.
* Perform system maintenance tasks, such as applying SAP notes, implementing support packs, and maintaining system documentation.
* Design and implement security measures, including role\-based access controls and user authorization setup.
* Collaborate with functional consultants and business stakeholders to understand technical requirements and propose appropriate solutions.
* Provide technical expertise and guidance to the project team, ensuring adherence to best practices and standards.
* Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical issues in the SAP system and integrated third\-party systems, using your deep technical knowledge in SAP Public Cloud and SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI).
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, integration setup, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest SAP technologies and advancements, identifying opportunities for system optimization and improvement.


**Skills**
* 7\+ years of experience as an SAP Technical Consultant or similar role.
* Strong skills in SAP technical administration, including system configuration, monitoring, and performance tuning.
* Deep technical knowledge in SAP Public Cloud and SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI).
* Experience troubleshooting integration issues between SAP and third\-party systems.
* Proven ability to control transport movements and manage release management processes.
* Experience leading technical upgrades and system patching activities.
* Proficient in SAP security and role setup, including role\-based access controls and user authorization.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Experience with integrated third\-party systems such as Salesforce.com, Replicon, and SAP SuccessFactors is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at various levels of the organization.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and deliver high\-quality results.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent experience..


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
*At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.*

 VP – Product
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Product Manager – Data \& Integrations** 
 to own the core data platform and integration ecosystem powering a growing healthcare technology business serving the US market.
   

  

 You will work closely with engineering, operations, and business teams to build a
 **scalable data layer, payer/third\-party integrations, data pipelines, and data quality framework** 
 that powers multiple products.
   

  

 What You Will Own
   

  

* Own and evolve the canonical data model based on the US healthcare claims lifecycle.
* Lead payer, clearinghouse, EDI, API, and third\-party integrations.
* Work with transaction formats such as 837, 835, 270/271 and 276/277\.
* Own 835/ERA parsing and payment\-posting logic.
* Design scalable client data onboarding processes across different EHR/PM systems.
* Define data contracts and requirements for Azure SQL, Snowflake and data pipelines.
* Establish data\-quality standards covering freshness, completeness, reconciliation and SLAs.
* Work with engineering to define APIs, mappings, integration specifications and technical requirements.
* Ensure appropriate PHI handling, data masking, access controls and compliance with HIPAA/SOC 2 requirements.
* Partner with operations teams to identify data and integration issues and drive product improvements.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

**Must Have**
* 4–7 years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Technical Business Analysis or Solution Architecture.
* Experience working on data platforms, integrations, APIs or technical products.
* Strong SQL skills — SQL will be assessed during the interview process.
* Hands\-on understanding of REST APIs, file feeds, SFTP, webhooks, retries and reconciliation.
* Strong understanding of data modelling and data warehousing concepts.
* Excellent written communication skills for creating product specifications, data dictionaries and integration documentation.
* B.Tech/B.E. or equivalent technical qualification.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Experience in US Healthcare / Revenue Cycle Management (RCM).
* Knowledge of X12 EDI – 837, 835, 270/271, 276/277\.
* Experience with healthcare clearinghouses such as Availity, Waystar, Change Healthcare/Optum or TriZetto.
* Exposure to EHR/PM systems such as Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks or AdvancedMD.
* Experience with Snowflake, Azure SQL, dbt or similar data pipeline technologies.
* Experience transitioning a services\-led process into a scalable product/platform.


 Why Join?
   

  

 This is an opportunity to own a
 **foundational data and integrations platform** 
 rather than a standalone product feature. You will work directly with live healthcare data, engineering and operations teams, with your work having a direct impact on
 **client collections and business outcomes** 
 .

title: SAP-BODS-Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a SAP\-BODS\-Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data\-driven decision\-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your experience in data migration and SAP BODS, working with SAP functional and technical consultants to analyze data migration requirements and design appropriate solutions. You will also provide advisory services to understand and address data management issues.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyzing client data migration requirements and legacy data structures to design effective migration solutions
* Collaborating with SAP functional and technical consultants to address data migration challenges and optimize processes
* Designing and implementing data migration frameworks using SAP Data Services and Information Steward
* Managing data migration projects, including building, testing, and executing migrations with tools like SAP SDS LSMW and SAP Migration Cockpit
* Conducting preload and post\-load validation of migration results and advising on data cleansing strategies
* Performing migration dress rehearsals, cutover tasks, and providing post go\-live support
* Developing data models and performing complex data analysis to support data\-driven decision\-making
* Creating technical specification documents to guide the development of data services jobs
* Supporting data cleansing and validation activities using tools such as Information Steward, Excel, and SQL
* Advising clients on data management strategies and techniques to enhance data quality and optimize data management processes


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications in SAP Data and Analytics solutions, including SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Warehouse (BW/4HANA), SAP Data Intelligence, or related data platform credentials
* Demonstrating proficiency in Snaplogic for data migration
* Utilizing SAP BODS and LTMC for data migration projects
* Designing data migration solutions with SAP Data Services
* Managing data cleansing activities using Information Steward
* Analyzing complex data migration requirements and legacy data
* Excelling in data integration and data quality improvement plans

title: Senior DBA (SQL)
description:
BOLD seeks a senior professional to provide support for various MS SQL databases. This person will perform database structure and software maintenance and implementations, support database tuning and consultation, and assist with database configuration implementation. The person will also participate in incident, change, and problem\-management activities
   

  

**Job Description**
**ABOUT THIS TEAM**
 Infrastructure team provides various services including automation, observability, cloud/server/network architectures, CICD, infrastructure as code, database administration, incident management, vendor management, security and compliance, and acquiring new skills. These services help to improve efficiency, reduce errors, and ensure fast and reliable application releases while maintaining security and compliance. TechOps help teams monitor applications and infrastructure, create resilient infrastructure, identify and resolve IT service issues, manage vendors, and ensure cloud security and compliance. The team also focuses on continuous learning and implementing new technologies to provide better value to the organization.
   

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
* Enhancing the scalability and performance of existing database architecture.
* Protecting data by developing data security and restoration policies, procedures, and controls.
* Conducting diagnostic tests and evaluating performance metrics.
* Developing procedures to ensure data integrity and quality.
* Performing database maintenance, migration, and upgrading hardware and software.
* Documenting processes and complying with best practices in database management.


**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**
* Strong understanding of SQL Server (IaaS and PaaS based on Azure) and on\-premise SQL Server setup.
* Strong understanding of Database concepts, SQL Architecture
* Automation experience with Powershell or Python
* Hands\-on experience in Unix/Linux command line options.
* Experience on DB migrations, maintenance and optimization strategies
* Experience in implementing operational automation using automation tools / scripts.
* Knowledge of indexes, index management, and statistics.
* Experience in Performance Tuning, Query Optimization, using Performance Monitor, SQL Profiler and other related monitoring and troubleshooting tools
* Ability to detect and troubleshoot SQL Server\-related CPU, memory, I/O, disk space and other resource contention.
* Experience in troubleshooting and resolving database integrity issues, performance issues, blocking \& deadlocking
* Experience with data modelling, database architecture and design
* Experience with backups, restores and recovery models.
* Knowledge of High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) options for Azuer PAAS,MSSQL Server
* Capacity Planning (Backup Share, Disk, CPU, Memory etc)
* Able to manage demanding stakeholders on technical solutions and align architects.


**EXPERIENCE\-**
* Sr. DBA \- 4\.5 years\+


**BENEFITS**
**Outstanding Compensation**
* Competitive salary
* Tax\-friendly compensation structure
* Bi\-annual bonus
* Annual Appraisal
* Equity in company


**100% Full Health Benefits**
* Group Mediclaim, personal accident, \& term life insurance
* Group Mediclaim benefit (including parents' coverage)
* Online Health (OPD) Consultation Benefit
* Personal accident and term life insurance coverage


**Flexible Time Away**
* 24 days paid leaves
* Declared fixed holidays
* Paternity and maternity leave
* Compassionate and marriage leave
* Covid leave (up to 7 days)


**ADDITIONAL BENEFITS**
* Internet and home office reimbursement
* In\-office catered lunch, meals, and snacks
* Certification policy
* Cab pick\-up and drop\-off facility


**About BOLD**
**We Transform Work Lives**
 As an established global organization, BOLD helps people find jobs. Our story is one of growth, success, and professional fulfillment. We create digital products that have empowered millions of people in 180 countries to build stronger resumes, cover letters, and CVs. The result of our work helps people interview confidently, finding the right job in less time. Our employees are experts, learners, contributors, and creatives.
